anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all time intervals, indicating potential overutilization or a bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles or opportunities, suggesting it may not be functioning as expected.
Trading system shows no active trades or profit/loss, which is unusual for a trading platform.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load average.
Review and potentially restart AI modules to ensure they are functioning and generating insights.
Evaluate trading strategies and system configurations to ensure trades are being executed as expected.

recommendations.action: Conduct a detailed analysis of CPU usage to identify and address any processes causing high load.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, impacting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Restart and test AI modules to ensure they are operational and contributing to trading decisions.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity suggests a malfunction, which could lead to missed trading opportunities and reduced platform effectiveness.

recommendations.action: Audit trading algorithms and configurations to confirm they are correctly set up and capable of executing trades.
recommendations.rationale: Lack of active trades and zero total profit/loss may indicate issues with strategy execution or market conditions.
